{"id":"t1","name":"URL Shortener Service","complexity":"simple","design_type":"system","rubric":"system_design","prompt_template":"generation/design_system.j2","variables":{"system_name":"URL Shortener Service","problem_statement":"Design a highly available URL shortening service similar to bit.ly or TinyURL.
The service must accept long URLs and generate unique, compact short codes that
redirect users to the original destination with minimal latency. The system should
handle a large volume of read-heavy traffic, as the ratio of redirects to new URL
creations is expected to exceed 100:1. The service must support analytics tracking
for each shortened URL, including click counts, geographic distribution, referrer
information, and temporal access patterns. Users should be able to create custom
vanity slugs subject to availability, and the system must gracefully handle slug
collisions during generation. The platform must provide both a web interface and a
RESTful API for programmatic access, with rate limiting to prevent abuse. URLs
should support optional expiration policies and the system must handle link rot
detection for destination URLs.
","hard_constraints":["Support storage and management of at least 100 million shortened URLs","Redirect latency must be under 10ms at the 95th percentile","System availability must meet or exceed 99.99% uptime SLA","Support custom vanity slugs with conflict detection and resolution","All redirects must be idempotent and safe for concurrent access","API rate limiting of 100 requests per minute per authenticated user"],"use_cases":["Shorten a long URL and receive a compact, shareable short link","Redirect users from a short URL to the original destination with minimal latency","View analytics dashboards showing click counts, geographic data, and referrer sources","Create and manage custom alias slugs for branded or memorable short links","Programmatically create and manage short URLs via RESTful API","Set expiration policies on shortened URLs for time-limited campaigns"],"complexity_drivers":["Extremely high read-to-write ratio requiring optimized caching and read replicas","Short code generation must avoid collisions while maintaining compact length","Real-time analytics ingestion at scale without impacting redirect latency","Global distribution for low-latency redirects across geographic regions"]}}
